environment: docker compose stack with src/ and config/ mounted into the codemie container; frontend dev server on 5173

results.name: Admin page renders from declarations
results.evidence: Customer Configuration tab present; card shows label, description, a switch and a textarea, all generated from the declaration payload

results.name: Override/default marker and reset control
results.evidence: marker read 'Default from config' with no reset control before the first write, 'Overridden' with 'Reset to default' after

results.name: Save persists the declared fields
results.evidence: PUT stored {enabled:true, text:...}; dynamic_config row CUSTOMER_CONFIG__CHAT_DISCLAIMER, value_type STRING, JSON payload

results.name: Change visible without a manual reload
results.evidence: navigating to Chat in the same tab, without F5, showed the new disclaimer

results.name: Override applied before the enabled filter
results.evidence: chatDisclaimer is disabled in YAML yet appeared in the anonymous GET /v1/config once enabled from the admin page

results.name: Public endpoint stays anonymous
results.evidence: GET /v1/config returned the merged result with no credentials

results.name: Disclaimer shown below the chat input, non-dismissible
results.evidence: rendered under the composer, no dismiss control, banner untouched

results.name: Links render as clickable
results.evidence: two anchors with href to example.com, target=_blank, rel='noopener noreferrer'

results.name: Truncation with ellipsis and full-text tooltip
results.evidence: 423-character text clamped to two lines (line-clamp-2, scrollHeight > clientHeight) with data-tooltip-content carrying the full text

results.name: Block markup flattened inline
results.evidence: input containing a heading, a list and a blockquote produced only STRONG and A elements, offsetHeight 16px, no block tags

results.name: Reset restores the deployment default
results.evidence: 'Reset to default' removed the row (0 rows in dynamic_config), the marker returned to 'Default from config' and the component left the public config

results.name: Audit trail
results.evidence: with ACTIVITY_EVENTS_ENABLED on, an update and a reset each produced a row with old/new value and a non-null actor_id (FK to users resolved); rows removed afterwards

results.name: Sanitisation on write
results.evidence: javascript: link rejected 400; the same link hidden behind javascript: also rejected 400; 'AT&T' stored and displayed verbatim, not HTML-escaped

results.name: Invalid payloads store nothing
results.evidence: undeclared field 'name' rejected 400; undeclared component features:webSearch rejected 404; the previously stored value survived both

cleanup: override row deleted, audit rows from the verification removed, .env restored byte-identical, container restarted
